concept: VPC endpoints: S3/DynamoDB gateway endpoints instead of NAT (savings)
tests: How to cut NAT gateway data processing charges when functions in a VPC access S3 and DynamoDB.
expected: Gateway VPC endpoints for S3 and DynamoDB — traffic stays on the private AWS network with no per-GB charge. Triggers: "NAT gateway data processing charges", "access S3 and DynamoDB from VPC".
why_not: Moving functions out of the VPC can break access to private resources; Lambda memory doesn't affect network costs; there is no "bigger" NAT gateway with a lower per-GB price.
